title: Warnings and opportunities in AI
text:
This was thoughtful discussion of recent issues related to AI, and ominous warnings and resignations at leading AI labs (i.e. Jacob Coxon at Anthropic after only 6 weeks). The Judge Wapner pushed Brad Gertsner of Altimeter, who I thought made a spirited defense!  Worth watching.

And here's a link about the latest bad news where AI is upstaging all humans ever: solving unsolvable math problems!! 

https://www.wsj.com/tech/ai/ai-math-millennium-prize-safety-openai-anthropic-05179825?st=8gXi5C&reflink=article_gmail_share

"The flickering dream that there’s still a human role in mathematics isn’t completely killed off by this,” Timothy Gowers told me. “But my guess is that if you’ve got a model that’s capable of doing this, it will be capable of doing lots of other things.”  Timothy Gowers also said, “I don’t want to say it’s all over, but I certainly don’t want to say it’s not all over.”
